items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Cause Barry Martin is working up a deal for me to make a tour with his band.

ctx.x: I think it was Cavalier. Yeah, I'm more than sure it was Cavalier. Because we had Tom Jefferson on trumpet at that time. Well, anyway, after we got through playing in Frisco, where we came on back home, where Elton, he stopped off in Los Angeles, so he was going to make up his mind to stay there. Well, sure enough, he did. So we came on back home, and we started to play a little odd jobs around town, you know, until something else was popped. So sure enough, came the word from England that they wanted to ban over…
